implementation: Codex annotation precedence and auto/prompt/writes/approve routing
Strict automatic review bypasses hints and remembered approvals
Final execution binds registration/schema/arguments and preserves cancellation/results
Live-origin-bound nested Computer Use review with synchronous sensitive checks
Required human input never reaches automatic inference
Pi MCP config, stdio/HTTP transports and scoped OAuth storage retained
limits: Approval-only elicitation forms are supported. Nonempty input forms and URL authentication requests are declined by this adapter; it does not fabricate input.

Account identity is bound when supplied by the registered provider metadata.
Default transport/config helpers use the version-qualified Pi 0.99.1 module seam because they are not re-exported by its package root.
Final Docker/live qualification follows the remaining changes.
